name: Onboarding
primary_user_goal: Get set up and understand Notion's basic value quickly
business_goal: Activate new users and reduce early churn by demonstrating value
exit_point: User reaches their first workspace with initial content

name: Page Creation
primary_user_goal: Create a new page and start adding content
business_goal: Drive content creation and engagement with the platform
entry_point: New page button in sidebar or slash command
exit_point: User typing in new page or selecting a template

name: Template Selection
primary_user_goal: Find and use a pre-built template to get started faster
business_goal: Accelerate time-to-value and showcase platform capabilities
